layout: Full scrollable profile page. Desktop: 2-column (left profile info, right schedule). Mobile: single column stacked. White bg.
elements: COVER PHOTO: 16:9 ratio, gym/action shot. Top of page
PROFILE HEADER: Overlapping cover photo bottom
Name (bold, navy h2) next to avatar
Badges row: Tier (Silver/Gold/Pro), Verified (✓ green), Female Only (♀ pink) if applicable
Star rating (★4.8) with review count '(23 reviews)'
INFO BAR: Horizontal row of 3 stats — Sessions Completed (47) | Response Rate (98%) | Trust Score (4.9/5)
PRICING CARD: White bg, 16px radius, shadow. Shows per session price and package options. 'Rp XX/session' large text. 'See packages' link
BIO: 2-3 lines, expandable with 'Show more'. Navy text, 16px
SPECIALTY TAGS: Row of clickable chips — Strength Training, HIIT, Yoga, Calisthenics, dll
RESPONSE HOURS: Small chip 'Typically replies in <1 hour' with clock icon
ONLINE COACHING: Badge if enabled — 'Online coaching available' with video icon
CLIENT TESTIMONIALS: Horizontal scrollable carousel of quote cards. Each: '...' quote text, client name, star rating

SCHEDULE: Section header 'Available Schedule'. Mini 7-day calendar showing current week. Green dots on available days. Tap a date → time slots appear below. Each slot: time (e.g. 07:00-08:00), price, 'Book' button
STICKY CTA: 'Book Session' button fixed at bottom — orange (#FF8A34), full width, large
notes: Trust-building screen. Verified badge, trust score, testimonials all visible above the fold. Schedule is interactive — tapping a date shows slots without page reload.
